name: @pipeworx/mcp-imei

tools.name: validate_imei
tools.description: Validate an IMEI (15 digits, with Luhn check) or IMEISV (16 digits, no check). Keyless/offline. Returns validity and the parts: TAC (Type Allocation Code, first 8), serial number, and check digit. Spaces/dashes ignored. Validates the number, not the device.

tools.name: imei_check_digit
tools.description: Compute the Luhn check digit for the first 14 digits of an IMEI (use to complete or repair an IMEI).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-imei forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the imei pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
